blind.description: A wooden armor stand displaying medieval armor. It rests on a four-legged cross-shaped wooden base with a central vertical post. The display features a chainmail hauberk under a halved red-and-white fabric surcoat bound at the waist by a brown leather belt with a hanging strap. Atop the post rests a metallic kettle hat helmet with a raised center ridge and riveted rim. Surfaces are solid, textured, and intact with no floating parts or mesh errors.
blind.from_above: A rounded metallic helmet with a distinct center crest and circular brim, flanked by the tops of chainmail shoulders/sleeves extending outward.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly 4.5 to 4.8 feet tall (about four-fifths the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide across the shoulders/base.
